title: File:Beijing Olympic Green.jpg
claims: The image is an aerial daylight view of the Olympic Green in Beijing, showing the central axis, the lake, the National Stadium (Bird's Nest), the National Aquatics Center and surrounding venues and roads.

Commons describes the photograph as Beijing Olympic Green, featuring the National Stadium and National Aquatics Center; it is a district-level view, not the finish arch, finish line, timing mat or a race-day road closure.
The author is Picrazy2; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2017-07-06; the original is 7,234 x 4,139 pixels and 17,398,612 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 549 copy of 181,090 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Picrazy2, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
